note: Klaxon gallery app on the iOS SIMULATOR (iPhone 17 Pro Max, arm64, software Metal/GLES translation). Windowed fps + avg render work time per frame (600-frame windows, from the mobile benchmark log in host.zig). GPU backends are vsync-capped at 60 fps — the ms/frame work time is the comparable metric. Non-black % = screenshot pixel analysis of the rendered gallery.
device: iPhone 17 Pro Max simulator (iOS 26.x, arm64, Apple Silicon Mac)
app: com.klaxon.gallery (728-node widget tree, ganesh/graphite/raster backends via -Dios-backend)

backends.name: ganesh-metal
backends.notes: fastest GPU backend on the simulator (~2x faster than Graphite Metal)

backends.name: graphite-metal
backends.notes: reference backend; screenshot is the pixel-diff baseline for the other GPU backends

backends.name: graphite-dawn
backends.notes: 99.67% pixel-identical to graphite-metal; ~1.6 ms/frame Dawn overhead on the sim

backends.name: ganesh-gles
backends.api: Ganesh over OpenGL ES 3 (deprecated API, translated by the simulator)
backends.notes: 98.94% pixel-identical to graphite-metal; GLES->Metal translation is slow on the simulator

backends.name: raster
backends.api: CPU raster + SDL software renderer/texture upload
backends.notes: UPPER BOUND: did not complete a 600-frame window in 330 s (< 1.8 fps, > 555 ms/frame) — renders correctly but the SDL software texture-upload present path dominates on the simulator
